findings.summary: Base UI Button defaults nativeButton to true; non-button render targets (our asChild links) need nativeButton={false}. Docs also advise against rendering links as buttons through render.
Migration guide: asChild becomes render; leaving asChild on a Button wrapping a link yields invalid button-in-anchor nesting.

notChecked: No specific upstream bug report found by web search; GitHub issue trackers not searched directly
Reddit and Hacker News not searched directly

differences.reference: Radix-nova Button renders a plain button with no type attribute (browser default is submit inside a form). Verified on the live reference: type attribute is null.
differences.branch: Base UI Button sets type='button' on native buttons (node_modules/@base-ui/react/internals/use-button/useButton.js line 184). Inside a form a Button no longer submits unless type='submit' is passed.
differences.how: Inspect any gallery button's attributes on the reference; read useButton.js in @base-ui/react.

differences.reference: Button renders data-variant and data-size attributes (verified on the reference: data-slot,data-variant,data-size,class).
differences.branch: base-nova button.json drops data-variant and data-size. No file in src selects on them today, but external CSS or tests would break.
differences.how: diff of radix-nova vs base-nova button.json

differences.branch: asChild removed; consumers need render={<Link />} plus nativeButton={false} for links. Prop type changes from React.ComponentProps<'button'> to ButtonPrimitive.Props.

apiChanges: Base UI adds data-disabled and focusableWhenDisabled/nativeButton props
notes: Decision made from the diff of the radix-nova and base-nova registry files (they differ) and a DOM check of the reference. The swap was not applied and no visual or interaction screenshots were compared (not checked), because the API and DOM differences already decide the outcome. The worktree was created from main; factory/base-ui was fast-forward merged in first to get tasks.json.
reasonNotMoved: base-nova button.json is not identical to radix-nova: it drops asChild (replaced by render + nativeButton), drops the data-variant/data-size attributes, and Base UI Button defaults to type='button' whereas the live Radix Button has no type attribute (default submit in forms). Verified on https://m3.khojlabs.com/gallery#components and in the @base-ui/react useButton source. See https://base-ui.com/react/components/button and https://shadcnspace.com/docs/getting-started/migrate-to-baseui. Retry if those API changes are accepted as intentional (or the component is patched to keep data-variant/data-size and an explicit type), then run the full visual and interaction comparison.
